column1: # Slot families named by reading the introducing class's callers and bodies, one method per virtual
# (the vtable position, never a vfunc_NN number). scripts/seed_names_game_propagated.py carries each to
# every function the family holds, in every region, and renames the overrides that spell it otherwise.
# A row whose <introducer> is `-` names one address: <slot> is the address, <method> the full name.

column5: <evidence>

igInsightCore_AddManager (0x236ab0) appends the manager, stores the core in _insight (+12) and calls slot 21 (lw t9,92); overrides add the manager to the scheduler (beSystem/beDemoManager/beCri igInsightCore_AddToScheduler) or wire receivers/renderers (igViewerSceneInfoManager, already named Activate; docs/engine/viewer-scene-info-manager.md)

igInsightCore_RemoveManager (0x236b10) calls slot 22 (lw t9,96) before clearing _insight and dropping the manager; overrides remove themselves from the scheduler/renderers (igViewerSceneInfoManager already Deactivate)

the core start 0x2371f0 calls every manager's slot 23 (+0x64) in list order before resuming the timer (docs/engine/system-clock.md); overrides resolve sibling managers and create run-time lists (be_Start, beSystem_Start, beDemoManager_Start)
the core stop 0x237280 pauses the timer then calls every manager's slot 24 (+0x68) (docs/engine/system-clock.md); be/beSystem/beDemoManager overrides already Stop

igInsightCore_AddInfo offers each loaded info to every manager's slot 25 (lw t9,108) and stops at the first that returns non-zero; beBaseInfoManager's default appends a matching info and its rams; igViewerSceneInfoManager already AddInfo

the core's manager-wide cleanup 0x2370c0 calls every manager's slot 26 (+0x70) and then releases its own info list (docs/engine/lua-loading-ownership.md); beBaseInfoManager's default releases _infoList; igViewerSceneInfoManager already RemoveAllInfo
igSerialScheduler's run loop calls slot 27 (SchedulerManager::update) on every scheduled manager each frame; be/beSystem/beDemoManager/igViewerSceneInfoManager already Update

beBaseInfoManager's AddInfo (slot 25 default 0x3787a0) appends an accepted info to _infoList and then calls slot 28 (v120) with it, before walking its rams; only the empty default 0x378400 exists. Alternative: AcceptInfo

AddInfo sets each ram's _parentManager/_parentInfo/_ramNo and calls slot 29 (v124) per ram; nearly every override registers the ram with the messenger (beMessenger_RegisterReceiver[FromInfo]), some also create per-ram work (beWeapon, beTextureCtrl, beSound). Not RegisterReceiver: beModelCtrl's slot 29 registers MODELCTRL and then calls its own slot 37, which Player/Enemy name RegisterReceiver
beBaseInfoManager's Update (slot 27 default 0x378bc0) walks every info's rams while beSystem_IsRunning and _isUpdateRun and calls slot 31 with each ram; slot 27 keeps Update (igInfoManager)

called by beBaseInfoManager's Start (slot 23 default, before resolving _system/_messenger) and by its RemoveAllInfo (slot 26 default, before releasing _infoList): overrides resolve the managers they use and drop per-scene state (beMatCtrl/beSound/beAction2/beSwitchCtrl already Prepare). Alternative: Reset

beMessenger_DispatchSelected calls slot 33 (+140) with (ram, message text) only when slot 34 returned 0; overrides resolve the text against their message enum (beModelCtrl, beCameraCtrl, beSelectCtrl...). Alternative: OnMessageName

beMessenger_DispatchSelected first calls slot 34 (+144) with (ram, beMessengerWork *) and falls back to slot 33 when its low byte is 0; the default 0x378410 returns 0; 8 overrides already OnMessage (beSound, beNDMWGameRam, beNDMWSaveIntf, beNDMWLoadCtrl2...)

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); beModelCtrl's AddInfo (0x390de0) accepts an info only when slot 35(info->_kindString) returns 1; overrides strcmp against KIND_*; Player/Enemy already IsKind

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); beModelCtrl's message handler calls slot 36 on GENERATE (docs/engine/mdl-player.md); Player/Enemy already OnGenerate

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); beModelCtrl's slot 29 registers the ram under MODELCTRL/HIT* and then calls slot 37 for the subclass's own receiver (PLAYER, PLAYER2...); Player/Enemy already RegisterReceiver; default 0x390f70 is empty

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); beModelCtrl_UpdateKeyCtrl calls slot 38 while work->_isOnCtrl; the default 0x391b40 runs map/homing AI, Player reads the pad (already UpdateControl); replaces beNDMWMdlItem_Update

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); beModelCtrl_UpdateWaitCheck handles TurnY/Landing/Action/Moving/Rotation itself and calls slot 39 for any other _wCheckName (Player's Atck01-03); not UpdateWaitCheck, which is the non-virtual beModelCtrl_UpdateWaitCheck (0x394xxx). Alternative: UpdateCustomWaitCheck

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); message handler calls slot 40 on OFCTRL; Player already OnControlOff
beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); message handler calls slot 41 on ONFREEZE; Player already OnFreeze
beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); message handler calls slot 42 on REMOVE; Player already OnRemove

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); message handler calls slot 43 when the new sequence is SQ_ERAS; Player already OnErase

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); message handler calls slot 44 after any other sequence starts and its commands run; Player/Enemy already OnSequenceChange

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); message handler calls slot 45 on MSG_ACTION1 (the player's DROPITEM ACTION1 button); only beNDMWMdlItem overrides

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); beModelCtrl's per-ram update (slot 31) calls slot 46 every running frame after the key control and before the moves; PEBase updates status effects (UpdateStatus), MapBase/MapCursor follow the players. Alternative: keep UpdateStatus (PEBase's behaviour)

beModelCtrl's retail vtable 0x53adb0 has 48 slots (35/36 pure, 37-47 its defaults; data/vtables.json stops at the first null word); beModelCtrl's message handler (slot 33) first calls slot 47(ram, message) and returns at once when it answers 1; default returns 0; PEBase answers the status messages (OnStatusMessage), Player2 its own. Alternative: OnStatusMessage / OnExtraMessage

every beNDMWWindow's slot 21 is its step-machine Update (docs/engine/status-list-windows.md, shop-windows.md; the beNDMWListCtrl family is already Update); beNDMWWindow/beNDMWWindowCtrl records end at the pure slot 21, so the generator sees BaseEquip and WindowTitle as introducers
beNDMWListCtrl's own implementation presents i_stcursorleft/i_stcursorright at the given positions, the right arrow hidden for a single page

beNDMWListCtrl's own implementation: left stick/button without up/down steps _nowPage back, moves the arrow models and returns whether the page changed (docs status-list-windows.md: 'previous page'). Alternative: HandlePrevPage
beNDMWListCtrl's own implementation: right stick/button steps _nowPage forward up to _maxPage-1 and returns whether the page changed. Alternative: HandleNextPage

docs/engine/save-card-api.md: slot 22 polls once per frame and returns 1 when the request is finished, 0 while a card request is in flight (every beSv*Api override). Not Poll: beSvConnectCheck_Poll (0x3ada60) is a non-virtual of the same class
docs/engine/save-card-api.md: slot 23 copies _result into the beSvDeliver and sets _isEndOperat (every override; GetFreeSize also reports capacities)

every override returns beNDMWItemBase_RequestDataBase(status, <db name>) (weapon, armor1, armor2, abChip, conItem, insItem, impItem, pcTech); beNDMWItemBase_GetRecordInt/_Bool/_String call slot 21 (docs/engine/item-database.md)
docs/engine/item-database.md: on disks and consumables slot 22 uses the item on a player (gameRam, playerNo); base default empty
every override packs _recNo/_isEquip/_kindNo (+_pocket/_revision/_kazu) into one inventory word (item-database.md)
every override unpacks an inventory word into the same fields (item-database.md)

igInsightCore's plugin loader (0x236ca0 -> 0x236dd0) appends each igInsightPlugin to _plugins and calls slot 21 with the core; overrides create their managers and igInsightCore_AddManager them (docs/engine/runtime-plugins.md). Alternative: Install
0x236e20 calls slot 22 with the core before removing the plugin from _plugins (0x236e80 walks them in reverse); overrides igInsightCore_RemoveManager each manager. Alternative: Uninstall

beModelCtrl's per-ram update calls _rideOnData's slot 21 with the model node matrix, then carries the rider by the change of _oldMatrix; RideOn2 (conveyor) translates by _vector, RideOn3 (quicksand) pulls toward _worldPosition; base default empty. Alternative: UpdateMove
docs/engine/model-ctrl-sub-commands.md: slots 21 start, 22 update, 23 stop; beModelCtrlSubComBase_Update calls start at _startFrame (SCHitBox/SCEffect/SCSound overrides)

model-ctrl-sub-commands.md slot 22 update, called after start until it returns 0 (SCHitBox repeats start until _endFrame). The default 0x36f8b0 would be beModelCtrlSubComBase_Update, so the non-virtual driver 0x399d90 (adds the frame time to _runFrame and dispatches start/update) is renamed beModelCtrlSubComBase_Advance
model-ctrl-sub-commands.md slot 23 stop, called by beModelCtrlSubCom_StopAll/_StopType (SCEffect sends SQ_ERAS, SCSound fades the voice)

pure in igFile (0x530150); overrides take an OpenMode, return igResult and do nothing when already open (igAdxFile slot 21); slot 23 calls it with kRead/kReadBinary. 2 of 3 engine overrides already OpenWithMode; replaces igMemoryFile_Open
pure in igFile; native close returning nothing (igAdxFile clears the buffer and closes the ADXF handle); 2 of 3 already Close; replaces igPsx2File_CloseHandle

pure in igFile; stdio-style open (fileName, "rb"/"r") that sets the file name and returns the file or 0 (igAdxFile slot 23 calls slot 21); igMemoryFile/igMediaFile already OpenFile; replaces igPsx2File_Open
pure in igFile; stdio-style counterpart of OpenFile; igMemoryFile/igMediaFile already CloseFile; replaces igPsx2File_Close
pure in igFile; variadic (format, ...) returning a count (igAdxFile returns -1); igMemoryFile/igMediaFile already Printf; replaces igPsx2File_Print

between SetStack (35)/GetStack (36) and GetStackSize (38): refuses while running (slot 30 IsRunning) or for a size not 16-aligned, frees an owned stack and allocates the new one aligned (igPsx2Thread override)

igMovieManager's AddInfo calls the codec's slot 22 with (visual context, audio) before opening a movie; igCriMovieCodec's override stores _visualContext/_audioContext, initialises MWSFD once and sets _initialized; base empty

igMovieManager's AddInfo calls slot 23(movie) and fails the movie when it returns 0; igCriMovieCodec opens it (ADXT or MWPLY handle and its igCriMovieData, docs/engine/cri-movie-codec.md), paired with slot 24 igCriMovieCodec_Close; base returns 0
walks _movieList comparing each igMovieInfo's _path with the argument and returns its _state, 2 when none matches; beMovie's update treats 2 as finished (docs/engine/movie-controller.md)

the renderer visual-context setter (0x457ca0) calls slot 22 before dropping the old context and slot 21 (InitializeDrawing, an assert-string name) after taking the new one; igMovieRenderer's override runs igCriMovieCodec_ReleaseDrawing on every movie
igInsightCore's render (0x2377c0) calls every renderer's slot 23 and times the pass into _traversalTime, then slot 24 (Render) into _outputTime
igTransform's default (0x1e2d80) is `j igMatrix44f_Copy` into _m (+32); beTransformSync copies and forwards to every synced transform's slot 35; beModelCtrl sets its node matrix through it
igViewManager forwards its igEventReceiver slot 21 (keyboard key, pressed) to the view mode's slot 23; igViewMode's default 0x37aa70 is empty, igFlyMode handles keys. Alternative: OnKey
igViewManager forwards its receiver slot 22 (the dispatcher passes the cursor's normalised x, y) to slot 24; igRotateMode's override drags. Alternative: OnPointerMove
igViewManager forwards its receiver slot 23 (dispatcher button down/up, no controller lookup) to slot 25; igPickMode's override picks, igRotateMode's starts/stops the drag
igViewManager's receiver slot 24 (controller index, stick, x, y) applies a 0.3 dead zone and forwards to slot 26. Alternative: OnAxisEvent
igViewManager forwards its receiver slot 25 (controller index, button, pressed; the dispatcher's controller-button entry) to slot 27; igPickMode overrides
igViewManager_SetFrameTime converts the frame time to seconds and calls the view mode's slot 28 with it; beCameraMode advances its camera path by the elapsed time

igViewMode's model-change handler (slot 22, 0x464fa0) recomputes its matrices and calls slot 29 for change kind 0 (the view added to the model, igModel add-view sends {0,0,0}); beCameraMode/igCameraMode copy the camera into the view model and set fov/near/far
the same handler calls slot 30 for change kind 1 (view removed from the model); default empty
its own implementation appends an igRay (growing _rayList) set from two points and counts _rayCount; beHitLandModel's callers already spell the view method AddRay
its own implementation appends a beHitLandResultData (growing _hitdataList) with the hit, the order's _infoName and _ramNo, and counts _hitdataCount

igEventDispatcher's key down/up entries (word-named vfunc_40/41) call every receiver's slot 21 with (key, 1/0); igHotKeyEventReceiver runs the binding whose key code matches on press, igViewManager forwards to the view mode; beKeyboardReceiver overrides only this slot. Note the GuiLibrary.h local view calls slot 25 onKeyEvent (that slot is the controller button)

igCameraMode/beCameraMode OnAttach call the mode's camera's slot 33 (lw t9,140) when the mode is added to the view model, before copying its fov/near/far into it; igCamera's own body is empty and no PS2 class overrides it; the GameCube and Xbox builds' igDOFCamera overrides it to switch its _shader (igDOFShader) on (_bEnabled) and load it with the camera's _blurriness, _focusDistance, field of view and clip planes. Alternative: Enable

igCameraMode/beCameraMode OnDetach call the mode's camera's slot 34 (lw t9,144) when the mode is removed from the view model; igCamera's own body is empty and no PS2 class overrides it; the GameCube and Xbox builds' igDOFCamera overrides it to switch its _shader (igDOFShader) off (_bEnabled cleared). Alternative: Disable

non-virtual driver of the sub-commands (adds the system frame time to _runFrame, at _startFrame sets _isOneSet and calls slot 21 Start, afterwards slot 22 Update; returns 0 when done, docs/engine/model-ctrl-sub-commands.md); renamed so the slot-22 default 0x36f8b0 can be beModelCtrlSubComBase_Update. Alternative: _Run
